sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Best guide and build for Nicole from ZZZ (Zenless Zone Zero). Nicole is an rank character with the Ether attribute who belongs to the Support Specialty and who is part of the Cunning Hares faction.
 The leader of the odd-job agency the Cunning Hares, who accept all kinds of Hollow-related commissions. She's been on the streets for many years, and has a reputation among her peers as being exceedingly cunning. She's been blacklisted by many clients due to her all-or nothing approach. She loves money, but is surprisingly bad at managing it, leaving the
Cunning Hares constantly on the edge of bankruptcy and owing many debts.

 To learn more about Nicole check the sections below. Use the tabs to quickly switch to the kind of information you're looking for.

sections.heading: Ratings
sections.text: This tier list assesses Agents (characters) based on their combat potential in Zenless Zone Zero's most demanding contents - Deadly Assault (DA) and Shiyu Defense (SD) . Please keep in mind Zenless Zone Zero is a skill-based game and each character has a different playstyle, difficulty level and even special tricks and combos. Zenless Zone Zero is also a team based game and it's only by combining both these factors to the highest level a character can reach optimal performance.

sections.heading: Pros
Cons
sections.text:
Really low DEF Shred uptime, requires constant management, may even require her to intervene in the midst of a Stun window.

 DEF Shred is not only completely antisynergistic with Rupture Agents but also makes PEN Ratio less valuable. Keep this in mind when building a team including Nicole.

sections.heading: Intro & Unique Mechanic
sections.text:
Nicole is an A-rank Ether Support Agent whose primary role is to amplify the damage of your damage dealers in many ways.
 Underneath her portrait in combat a series of bullets is listed, which can be consumed via her Basic and Dash Attacks to enhance them. When landing her Energy Fields or enhanced attacks, units get 25% Ether DMG Bonus against the target and a staggering 40% DEF Shred debuff to struck enemies for 3.5s.
 Although she’s primarily suited to Ether Agents, having hefty DMG Bonuses, she provides general increases via DEF Shred debuffs and CRIT Rate increases. For those who have the skill to capitalise on it, she also offers a high level of Anomaly application and Decibel generation, unlocking brand new routes and working as a universal Support in both Attacker and Anomaly teams.

sections.heading: Core Passive & Additional Ability
sections.text:
It’s through her Core Passive and Additional Ability that Nicole provides most of her value.
 As mentioned before, it’s by hitting enemies with her enhanced Basic and Dash Attacks that her debuffs are applied. This is only the case when bullets are used, however, and the most efficient way to reload them is by using her Special, EX Special, Chain Attack, and Ultimate.
 Using up Bullets isn’t the only way to apply debuffs, though, as she also does this via Energy Fields . She can generate them through:
 EX Special

 Ultimate

 Chain Attack

 These Energy Fields are particularly important; they have a large vacuum radius (further enhanced by her M4), increase the team’s CRIT RATE against targets by 15%, and most importantly, linger .
 The most difficult part about managing Nicole is how short her debuffs last, being only 3.5s. What’s worth noting is that this only begins ticking from the last hit - every hit from an attack that’d apply her debuff will refresh it. This means that in practice, her debuff can last for up to 7 seconds, depending on which skill is used.
 As they all do Ether DMG, this also works well with her Signature W-Engine, The Vault, meaning that despite the higher Energy cost for her EX Specials than most other Supports, she can sustain frequent usage of it in fights.

sections.heading: Basic Attack
sections.text: It’s through Basic Attacks that Nicole can apply her debuffs (if there are bullets to consume), so despite having terrible values, they’re very useful for that alone. It is often better to rely on her Dash Attack (due to its slight linger), but sometimes it can be preferable to fall back on her Basics, like at the start of Shiyu Defence to build enough Energy.

sections.heading: Dodge
sections.text:
Although Nicole will reload when using EX Specials, Chain Attacks and Ultimates, her standard Dash can also reload after a short while. This can be situationally useful in comps that demand many quickswaps as bullets tend to be used quickly. She also has 2 sets of Dash Attacks, which differ based on the directional inputs used.
 Holding any direction will have her spin around and strike enemies; outside of her Energy Fields, this is the primary way to refresh her debuff. It has a minor linger/multihit property, and as the debuff is applied by every hit, this functionally increases its duration slightly.
 Attempting to Dash Attack with no directional input will instead have her vault backwards and do a single shot. This does not apply her debuff, but has the added benefit of being one of the fastest (if not the fastest) Heavy Attack in the game, which is important for high level combos in certain team comps.
 Her Perfect Dodge is rather unremarkable, as it does not apply her debuff.

sections.heading: Assist
sections.text:
As far as Support Agents go, Nicole’s Assist and Assist Follow-Up have decent daze application, to the point 2-piece Shockstar and/or Impact % D6 have at times been used in niche scenarios. This is absolutely not recommended for the average player though, but worth observing as giving her a Defensive Assist isn’t a terrible choice depending on the circumstance.
 Her Assist Follow-Up specifically is already fast but can be made even faster, as it is dash cancellable once the shot is fired, doubling up as an easy transition to reapply her debuffs.
 Quick Assist is unremarkable, but like her neutral Dash Attack, very fast.

sections.heading: Special
sections.text:
Nicole’s EX Special is one of her most important attacks, applying her iconic Energy Field and having really strong values across the board. It does very good damage, applies a fair bit of Anomaly and generates a lot of Decibels.
 It can be charged by holding down the Special button on cast, and at M1 and above, this has the added benefit of increasing the duration of the Energy Field, meaning even more damage, Anomaly and Decibels.
 When used at point blank, the charging animation itself also contributes to all of the above, making it a powerhouse of a skill.
 There is also a hidden alternate EX Special that can be accessed by doing a full circle input on the joystick (→↓←↑→ on keyboard). Doing this will have her sit on her briefcase and charge the skill for even longer. Repeating the same input again leads to a “misfire”, a sort of mortar shot that goes up and lands on enemies, but this is not worth using due to the time it takes to get to it.
 As for her regular Special, it’s unremarkable and not worth using. It can reload bullets, but it’s even slower than a standard Dash.

sections.heading: Chain & Ultimate
sections.text:
Like with her Specials, both Nicole’s Chain Attack and Ultimate apply Energy Fields and reload her bullets. Compared to the default duration of her EX Special (if tapped), they last longer, making it more forgiving in regards to debuff application timings.
 Both of them are incredibly fast - among the fastest Chains and Ultimates in the game - meaning that unless a double Chain Attack is needed in a damage dealer, it is almost always worth using them in combos, as there will often be little to no time loss.
 In some circumstances, like if a damage dealer has their Ultimate in stock, Quick Assisting into them through these skills and interrupting the Quick Assist animation with their Ultimate cast can be a time save.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.text:
Nicole’s game plan is all about maximising her debuffs for critical periods. Besides that, how she plays tends to ride on the team comp and encounter.
 To start with, ensuring that her debuffs are up throughout all of a damage dealer’s stun burst is the most important skill to master early. If using The Vault as a W-Engine, the additional Energy Regen it provides means that it’s possible for Nicole to get multiple EX Special casts in a single stun period.
 Each team will have a unique combo, but as a good template, opening with her EX Special and then weaving in a Chain Attack, Ultimate and/or a second EX Special mid-stun serves to both ensure uptime of Drive Discs (be it Moonlight Lullaby or Astral Voice via Quick Assists) and maintain her debuffs.
 Merely tapping her EX Special is enough for most comps, but in certain teams where Anomalies are required, it can be useful to hold down her EX Special at melee range to maximise Anomaly application, but be careful to not do so at the cost of damage elsewhere and fit it in while the main damage dealer is taken up in their own attack animations.
 Optimising Nicole out of stun is where things get very difficult and what lands her the “Expert” tag. Different characters have different points in which they are taken up in skills but can be safely swapped out of; Zhu Yuan during her triple Shotshell finisher, Miyabi on a level 3 Shimotsuki, Evelyn as she casts her points Chain Attack, Alice on a level 3 Starshine Waltz, etc. Use these as opportunities to swap to Nicole and do Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, or EX Specials to refresh her debuff and - if using her EX - apply Anomaly and build Decibels on top.
 While it may be tempting to try and shoot for 100% uptime of her debuff, it’s not realistic to do so and often comes with a hefty opportunity cost. There’s no need to have her debuff applied on attacks that do little damage after all, so learning when and where to prioritise swapping to Nicole is part of her skill expression.
 It’s worth noting that DEF Shred and PEN Ratio negatively affect the impact they have on enemies when paired together due to how damage is calculated - avoid pairing Nicole and Rina in a Double Support team setup for example, or building PEN Ratio on your Disc Drives/W-Engines if Nicole is present in the team.
 Even without exploiting Nicole’s Additional Ability reserved to Ether teams (which only adds to her value in those), she remains one of the most versatile Support Agents, and while she doesn’t function with Rupture Agents as they completely ignore her DEF Shred capabilities, with any Attack or Anomaly DPS Agents she’s often one of the strongest options available.
 Fully utilizing Nicole does take skill however, with her debuff uptime being difficult - but rewarding - to manage. As long as you learn how to work around her mechanics properly, she’s one of the best Support Agents in the game.

sections.heading: Best Disk Drives Sets
sections.text:
1

 Moonlight Lullaby ( 4 -PC)

 Gives 20% Energy Regen on the 2-piece, and most importantly the 4-piece is the best set for every Support-class Agent. This is because it provides not only more DMG Bonus than both Proto Punk and Swing Jazz (18%), but the duration of the buff is also much longer than both of them as well (25s), while the condition is also much easier to fulfill (it only requires casting an EX Special or Ultimate). It makes this set the best choice for all Supports and is only superceded by a fully stacked Astral Voice, which is not consistently upkept by most Agents.

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Nicole . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Zhu Yuan - Nicole is particularly outstanding with Zhu Yuan, because not only does she provide the usual DEF Shred debuffs and CRIT Rate buffs for Zhu Yuan to exploit, but they also activate each other's Additional Abilities which boosts Zhu Yuan's CRIT Rate even further and provides an Ether DMG boost to the whole party! This makes the pairing particularly outstanding, not to mention Nicole oftens fills in for Zhu Yuan's downtimes nicely by taking a short bit of field time compared to someone like Astra Yao.
 Harumasa - Very similarly to Zhu Yuan, Nicole and Harumasa make for an especially good Support-DPS pairing because Nicole fills in very slightly for the downtimes during which Harumasa has trouble making any use of his damage potential. His damage potential comes in windows and downtime needs to be filled with productive things: Nicole helps for that slightly, at least more so than Astra Yao, and provides roughly similar damage boosts when optimized, which makes the pairing particularly synergistic.

 Introduction
 Best guide and build for Nicole from ZZZ (Zenless Zone Zero). Nicole is an rank character with the Ether attribute who belongs to the Support Specialty and who is part of the Cunning Hares faction.
 The leader of the odd-job agency the Cunning Hares, who accept all kinds of Hollow-related commissions. She's been on the streets for many years, and has a reputation among her peers as being exceedingly cunning. She's been blacklisted by many clients due to her all-or nothing approach. She loves money, but is surprisingly bad at managing it, leaving the
Cunning Hares constantly on the edge of bankruptcy and owing many debts.

 Review

 Ratings
 This tier list assesses Agents (characters) based on their combat potential in Zenless Zone Zero's most demanding contents - Deadly Assault (DA) and Shiyu Defense (SD) . Please keep in mind Zenless Zone Zero is a skill-based game and each character has a different playstyle, difficulty level and even special tricks and combos. Zenless Zone Zero is also a team based game and it's only by combining both these factors to the highest level a character can reach optimal performance.

 Support
 T0.5
 Endgame Modes

 Pros & Cons
 Pros
 Amazing DEF Shred debuff that amplifies your party’s DMG by a ton. Additionally provides CRIT Rate at M6 and Ether DMG with her Additional Ability;

 Even has a DMG% debuff on her Signature W-Engine. All in all one of the strongest supportive potentials in the game by a long shot;

 Able to gather enemies in an Energy Field which is practical for Shiyu Defense etc.;

 Low field time, can swap in and out really easily, even in the middle of a stun combo. Also able to trigger Quick Assists efficiently;

 She’s free!

 There are very few cons to this character. She’s good with almost everyone. She requires minimal investment. Build Nicole.

 Cons
 Really low DEF Shred uptime, requires constant management, may even require her to intervene in the midst of a Stun window.

 DEF Shred is not only completely antisynergistic with Rupture Agents but also makes PEN Ratio less valuable. Keep this in mind when building a team including Nicole.

 Review
 Intro & Unique Mechanic
 Nicole is an A-rank Ether Support Agent whose primary role is to amplify the damage of your damage dealers in many ways.
 Underneath her portrait in combat a series of bullets is listed, which can be consumed via her Basic and Dash Attacks to enhance them. When landing her Energy Fields or enhanced attacks, units get 25% Ether DMG Bonus against the target and a staggering 40% DEF Shred debuff to struck enemies for 3.5s.
 Although she’s primarily suited to Ether Agents, having hefty DMG Bonuses, she provides general increases via DEF Shred debuffs and CRIT Rate increases. For those who have the skill to capitalise on it, she also offers a high level of Anomaly application and Decibel generation, unlocking brand new routes and working as a universal Support in both Attacker and Anomaly teams.
 Core Passive & Additional Ability
 It’s through her Core Passive and Additional Ability that Nicole provides most of her value.
 As mentioned before, it’s by hitting enemies with her enhanced Basic and Dash Attacks that her debuffs are applied. This is only the case when bullets are used, however, and the most efficient way to reload them is by using her Special, EX Special, Chain Attack, and Ultimate.
 Using up Bullets isn’t the only way to apply debuffs, though, as she also does this via Energy Fields . She can generate them through:
 EX Special

 Ultimate

 Chain Attack

 These Energy Fields are particularly important; they have a large vacuum radius (further enhanced by her M4), increase the team’s CRIT RATE against targets by 15%, and most importantly, linger .
 The most difficult part about managing Nicole is how short her debuffs last, being only 3.5s. What’s worth noting is that this only begins ticking from the last hit - every hit from an attack that’d apply her debuff will refresh it. This means that in practice, her debuff can last for up to 7 seconds, depending on which skill is used.
 As they all do Ether DMG, this also works well with her Signature W-Engine, The Vault, meaning that despite the higher Energy cost for her EX Specials than most other Supports, she can sustain frequent usage of it in fights.
 Basic Attack
 It’s through Basic Attacks that Nicole can apply her debuffs (if there are bullets to consume), so despite having terrible values, they’re very useful for that alone. It is often better to rely on her Dash Attack (due to its slight linger), but sometimes it can be preferable to fall back on her Basics, like at the start of Shiyu Defence to build enough Energy.
 Dodge
 Although Nicole will reload when using EX Specials, Chain Attacks and Ultimates, her standard Dash can also reload after a short while. This can be situationally useful in comps that demand many quickswaps as bullets tend to be used quickly. She also has 2 sets of Dash Attacks, which differ based on the directional inputs used.
 Holding any direction will have her spin around and strike enemies; outside of her Energy Fields, this is the primary way to refresh her debuff. It has a minor linger/multihit property, and as the debuff is applied by every hit, this functionally increases its duration slightly.
 Attempting to Dash Attack with no directional input will instead have her vault backwards and do a single shot. This does not apply her debuff, but has the added benefit of being one of the fastest (if not the fastest) Heavy Attack in the game, which is important for high level combos in certain team comps.
 Her Perfect Dodge is rather unremarkable, as it does not apply her debuff.
 Assist
 As far as Support Agents go, Nicole’s Assist and Assist Follow-Up have decent daze application, to the point 2-piece Shockstar and/or Impact % D6 have at times been used in niche scenarios. This is absolutely not recommended for the average player though, but worth observing as giving her a Defensive Assist isn’t a terrible choice depending on the circumstance.
 Her Assist Follow-Up specifically is already fast but can be made even faster, as it is dash cancellable once the shot is fired, doubling up as an easy transition to reapply her debuffs.
 Quick Assist is unremarkable, but like her neutral Dash Attack, very fast.
 Special
 Nicole’s EX Special is one of her most important attacks, applying her iconic Energy Field and having really strong values across the board. It does very good damage, applies a fair bit of Anomaly and generates a lot of Decibels.
 It can be charged by holding down the Special button on cast, and at M1 and above, this has the added benefit of increasing the duration of the Energy Field, meaning even more damage, Anomaly and Decibels.
 When used at point blank, the charging animation itself also contributes to all of the above, making it a powerhouse of a skill.
 There is also a hidden alternate EX Special that can be accessed by doing a full circle input on the joystick (→↓←↑→ on keyboard). Doing this will have her sit on her briefcase and charge the skill for even longer. Repeating the same input again leads to a “misfire”, a sort of mortar shot that goes up and lands on enemies, but this is not worth using due to the time it takes to get to it.
 As for her regular Special, it’s unremarkable and not worth using. It can reload bullets, but it’s even slower than a standard Dash.
 Chain & Ultimate
 Like with her Specials, both Nicole’s Chain Attack and Ultimate apply Energy Fields and reload her bullets. Compared to the default duration of her EX Special (if tapped), they last longer, making it more forgiving in regards to debuff application timings.
 Both of them are incredibly fast - among the fastest Chains and Ultimates in the game - meaning that unless a double Chain Attack is needed in a damage dealer, it is almost always worth using them in combos, as there will often be little to no time loss.
 In some circumstances, like if a damage dealer has their Ultimate in stock, Quick Assisting into them through these skills and interrupting the Quick Assist animation with their Ultimate cast can be a time save.

 How to play
 Nicole’s game plan is all about maximising her debuffs for critical periods. Besides that, how she plays tends to ride on the team comp and encounter.
 To start with, ensuring that her debuffs are up throughout all of a damage dealer’s stun burst is the most important skill to master early. If using The Vault as a W-Engine, the additional Energy Regen it provides means that it’s possible for Nicole to get multiple EX Special casts in a single stun period.
 Each team will have a unique combo, but as a good template, opening with her EX Special and then weaving in a Chain Attack, Ultimate and/or a second EX Special mid-stun serves to both ensure uptime of Drive Discs (be it Moonlight Lullaby or Astral Voice via Quick Assists) and maintain her debuffs.
 Merely tapping her EX Special is enough for most comps, but in certain teams where Anomalies are required, it can be useful to hold down her EX Special at melee range to maximise Anomaly application, but be careful to not do so at the cost of damage elsewhere and fit it in while the main damage dealer is taken up in their own attack animations.
 Optimising Nicole out of stun is where things get very difficult and what lands her the “Expert” tag. Different characters have different points in which they are taken up in skills but can be safely swapped out of; Zhu Yuan during her triple Shotshell finisher, Miyabi on a level 3 Shimotsuki, Evelyn as she casts her points Chain Attack, Alice on a level 3 Starshine Waltz, etc. Use these as opportunities to swap to Nicole and do Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, or EX Specials to refresh her debuff and - if using her EX - apply Anomaly and build Decibels on top.
 While it may be tempting to try and shoot for 100% uptime of her debuff, it’s not realistic to do so and often comes with a hefty opportunity cost. There’s no need to have her debuff applied on attacks that do little damage after all, so learning when and where to prioritise swapping to Nicole is part of her skill expression.
 It’s worth noting that DEF Shred and PEN Ratio negatively affect the impact they have on enemies when paired together due to how damage is calculated - avoid pairing Nicole and Rina in a Double Support team setup for example, or building PEN Ratio on your Disc Drives/W-Engines if Nicole is present in the team.
 Even without exploiting Nicole’s Additional Ability reserved to Ether teams (which only adds to her value in those), she remains one of the most versatile Support Agents, and while she doesn’t function with Rupture Agents as they completely ignore her DEF Shred capabilities, with any Attack or Anomaly DPS Agents she’s often one of the strongest options available.
 Fully utilizing Nicole does take skill however, with her debuff uptime being difficult - but rewarding - to manage. As long as you learn how to work around her mechanics properly, she’s one of the best Support Agents in the game.

 Teams & Synergy

 Synergy
 Below we list only the most important synergies for Nicole . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Zhu Yuan - Nicole is particularly outstanding with Zhu Yuan, because not only does she provide the usual DEF Shred debuffs and CRIT Rate buffs for Zhu Yuan to exploit, but they also activate each other's Additional Abilities which boosts Zhu Yuan's CRIT Rate even further and provides an Ether DMG boost to the whole party! This makes the pairing particularly outstanding, not to mention Nicole oftens fills in for Zhu Yuan's downtimes nicely by taking a short bit of field time compared to someone like Astra Yao.
 Harumasa - Very similarly to Zhu Yuan, Nicole and Harumasa make for an especially good Support-DPS pairing because Nicole fills in very slightly for the downtimes during which Harumasa has trouble making any use of his damage potential. His damage potential comes in windows and downtime needs to be filled with productive things: Nicole helps for that slightly, at least more so than Astra Yao, and provides roughly similar damage boosts when optimized, which makes the pairing particularly synergistic.
